description: This file defines CLI commands related to node status, description, and listing, including functions for formatting node data and handling command actions.

methods.name: formatVersionLabel
methods.description: Formats a raw version string, prefixing with 'v' if it starts with a digit and not already prefixed.

methods.name: resolveNodeVersions
methods.description: Determines core and UI versions of a node based on available version fields and platform.

methods.name: formatNodeVersions
methods.description: Creates a formatted string representing node's core and UI versions.

methods.name: formatPathEnv
methods.description: Formats a PATH environment variable string, shortening it for display.

methods.name: formatClientLabel
methods.description: Creates a label for a client based on clientId and clientMode.

methods.name: parseSinceMs
methods.description: Parses a duration string or number into milliseconds, with error handling.

methods.name: registerNodesStatusCommands
methods.description: Registers CLI commands ('status', 'describe', 'list') for node management.
